datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model MendeleyConfig {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  clientId      String?
  clientSecret  String?
  accessToken   String?
  refreshToken  String?
  tokenExpiresAt DateTime?
  connected     Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
}

model Reference {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  type        String   @default("article")
  citationKey String?
  title       String
  authors     String
  year        String?
  journal     String?
  volume      String?
  number      String?
  pages       String?
  doi         String?
  abstract    String?
  tags        String?
  notes       String?
  source      String   @default("manual")
  mendeleyId  String?  @unique
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([type])
  @@index([source])
}

// ─── Thesis Editor Models ─────────────────────────────────────

model Thesis {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  title         String    @default("Ma thèse de doctorat")
  subtitle      String?
  author        String    @default("Doctorant")
  field         String    @default("")
  university    String   @default("")
  status        String    @default("draft")
  structureMode String    @default("chapters") // "chapters" | "parts"
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt
  chapters      Chapter[]
  parts         Part[]
  cadrage       ThesisCadrage?
}

model Chapter {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  thesisId         String
  partId           String?
  order            Int
  number           String
  title            String
  content          String    @default("")
  wordCount        Int       @default(0)
  status           String    @default("draft")
  directorFeedback String?
  directorFeedbackAt DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt
  thesis           Thesis    @relation(fields: [thesisId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  part             Part?     @relation(fields: [partId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@unique([thesisId, order])
  @@index([thesisId])
}

model Part {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  thesisId  String
  title     String    @default("")
  order     Int
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  thesis    Thesis    @relation(fields: [thesisId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  chapters  Chapter[]

  @@unique([thesisId, order])
}

model CloudDriveConnection {
  id           String    @id @default(cuid())
  provider     String    @default("google_drive") // google_drive, onedrive, dropbox
  connected    Boolean   @default(false)
  email        String?
  displayName  String?
  accessToken  String?
  refreshToken String?
  tokenExpiresAt DateTime?
  lastSyncAt   DateTime?
  createdAt    DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt    DateTime  @updatedAt
}

// ─── Notebook (recherche assistée par IA sur sources) ────────

model ResearchSource {
  id         String   @id @default(cuid())
  title      String
  content    String
  sourceType String   @default("text")
  tags       String?
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt  DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([sourceType])
}

model AiToolConfig {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  tool        String   @unique
  apiKey      String?
  connected    Boolean  @default(false)
  extraConfig String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
}

model NotebookEntry {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  question  String
  answer    String
  sourceIds String   @default("")
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
}

// ─── License & Activation ────────────────────────────────────

model LicenseKey {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  keyHash         String   @unique          // SHA-256 hash of the license key
  keyPrefix       String                     // First 8 chars in clear for admin display
  licenseType     String   @default("standard") // standard | academic | premium | trial
  status          String   @default("active")    // active | revoked | expired
  maxActivations  Int      @default(3)
  currentActivations Int    @default(0)
  note            String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  expiresAt       DateTime?
  activations     Activation[]
}

model Activation {
  id           String     @id @default(cuid())
  licenseKeyId String
  sessionToken String     @unique          // Token stored in cookie
  deviceName   String?
  deviceFingerprint String?
  ipAddress    String?
  activatedAt  DateTime   @default(now())
  lastSeenAt   DateTime   @default(now())
  licenseKey   LicenseKey @relation(fields: [licenseKeyId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([sessionToken])
  @@index([licenseKeyId])
}

// ─── Cadrage préalable (ThesisFrame) ──────────────────────────

model ThesisCadrage {
  id        String    @id @default(cuid())
  thesisId  String    @unique
  status    String    @default("provisoire") // provisoire | valide | revise
  version   Int       @default(1)
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime  @updatedAt
  thesis    Thesis    @relation(fields: [thesisId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  fields    ThesisCadrageField[]
  versions  ThesisCadrageVersion[]
}

model ThesisCadrageField {
  id             String         @id @default(cuid())
  cadrageId      String
  fieldKey       String         // thematique, problematique, questions_recherche, etc.
  fieldValue     String         @default("")
  fieldMeta      String?        // JSON blob for sub-fields (objectives, methodology, etc.)
  isAiSuggestion Boolean        @default(false)
  editedByUser   Boolean        @default(false)
  createdAt      DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime       @updatedAt
  cadrage        ThesisCadrage  @relation(fields: [cadrageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([cadrageId, fieldKey])
}

model ThesisCadrageVersion {
  id        String         @id @default(cuid())
  cadrageId String
  version   Int
  snapshot  String         // JSON snapshot of all fields
  createdAt DateTime       @default(now())
  cadrage   ThesisCadrage  @relation(fields: [cadrageId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([cadrageId, version])
}

// ─── External Auth Providers (Auth0, Stytch, Warrant) ──────

model AuthProvider {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  provider    String   @unique          // "auth0" | "stytch" | "warrant"
  enabled     Boolean  @default(false)
  clientId    String?                    // API Key / Client ID
  clientSecret String?                   // Client Secret (encrypted at rest by env)
  domain      String?                    // Auth0 domain, Stytch project URL, Warrant API URL
  extraConfig String?                    // JSON: allowed connections, features, etc.
  connected   Boolean  @default(false)
  lastTestedAt DateTime?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  accounts    AuthAccount[]
}

model AuthAccount {
  id             String       @id @default(cuid())
  providerId     String
  provider       AuthProvider @relation(fields: [providerId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  providerUserId String                          // External user ID from provider
  email          String?
  name           String?
  avatarUrl      String?
  accessToken    String?                         // Encrypted
  refreshToken   String?                         // Encrypted
  tokenExpiresAt DateTime?
  metadata       String?                         // JSON: extra provider-specific data
  lastLoginAt    DateTime?
  createdAt      DateTime    @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime    @updatedAt

  @@unique([providerId, providerUserId])
  @@index([email])
}

// ─── Warrant: Authorization Policies ─────────────────────────

model WarrantPolicy {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  policyType  String                      // "feature_gate" | "role" | "resource_access"
  policyKey   String                       // e.g. "ai_writing", "export_pdf", "admin_panel"
  licenseTypes String                      // JSON array of license types that grant access
  description  String?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  @@unique([policyType, policyKey])
}

// ─── Custom Book Skills (user-imported books) ────────────

model CustomBookSkill {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  title         String
  author        String   @default("")
  coreConcept   String   @default("")
  frameworks    String   @default("[]") // JSON: Array<{name, description, when}>
  principles    String   @default("[]") // JSON: string[]
  techniques    String   @default("[]") // JSON: string[]
  antiPatterns  String   @default("[]") // JSON: string[]
  relevance     String   @default("[]") // JSON: Array<{chapterType, reason}>
  quickReference String  @default("")
  glossary      String   @default("") // JSON: Array<{term, definition}>
  fileName      String
  fileSize      Int      @default(0)
  status        String   @default("processing") // processing | ready | error
  errorMessage  String   @default("")
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
}

// ─── Vérification méthodologique (Module A + B) ────────────

model ElementAnalyse {
  id            String    @id @default(cuid())
  nom           String
  typeElement   String
  natureElement String
  sousAnalyse   String?
  source        String
  dateSource    DateTime?
  geojson       String?
  styleConfig   String?
  chapitreId    String?
  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt

  @@index([typeElement])
  @@index([natureElement])
}

model TypeAnalyseMethodologique {
  id                 String   @id @default(cuid())
  discipline         String
  nom                String
  elementsAttendus   String
  promptQuestionneur String?
  createdAt          DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([discipline, nom])
}

model SessionVerification {
  id               String   @id @default(cuid())
  siteEtudeId      String
  typeAnalyseId    String
  elementsManquants String
  questionsPosees  String
  reponses         String?
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime @default(now())
}

// ─── Onglet Recherche (bibliothèque + fiches + veille) ─────

model SourceBibliographique {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  titre         String
  auteurs       String   // JSON: [{nom, prenom}]
  annee         Int?
  doi           String?
  type          String   @default("article") // "article" | "ouvrage" | "these" | "rapport" | "chapitre"
  abstract      String?  // résumé original de la source, jamais généré par ThesisFrame
  journal       String?
  volume        String?
  pages         String?
  url           String?
  tags          String?  // JSON: string[]
  mendeleyId    String?
  zoteroId      String?
  chapitres     SourceChapitre[]
  fichesLecture FicheLecture[]
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([type])
  @@index([annee])
}

model SourceChapitre {
  sourceId   String
  source     SourceBibliographique @relation(fields: [sourceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  chapitreId String
  createdAt  DateTime @default(now())

  @@id([sourceId, chapitreId])
}

model FicheLecture {
  id             String   @id @default(cuid())
  sourceId       String
  source         SourceBibliographique @relation(fields: [sourceId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  chapitreId     String?
  problematique  String?  // rédigé par le chercheur — jamais pré-rempli par l'IA
  methode        String?
  resultatsCles  String?
  limites        String?
  positionnement String?  // en quoi cette source se rattache (ou s'oppose) à la thèse du chercheur
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt      DateTime @updatedAt

  @@index([sourceId])
  @@index([chapitreId])
}

model RechercheSauvegardee {
  id               String    @id @default(cuid())
  requete          String
  filtres          String?   // JSON: { discipline, periode, langue, type }
  alerteActive     Boolean   @default(false)
  derniereExecution DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt        DateTime  @updatedAt
}

// ─── Agile Roadmap (Sprints & Stories) ────────────────────────

model AgileSprint {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  thesisId    String
  sprintNumber Int      @unique
  phase        String   // "phase_0" | "phase_1" | "phase_2" | "phase_3" | "phase_4"
  title       String
  description  String   @default("")
  deliverable String   @default("")
  status      String   @default("todo") // todo | in_progress | done
  startedAt   DateTime?
  completedAt DateTime?
  order       Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @default(now())
  stories     AgileStory[]

  @@index([thesisId, phase])
}

model AgileStory {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  sprintId    String
  title       String
  description  String   @default("")
  status      String   @default("todo") // todo | in_progress | done
  order       Int      @default(0)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  sprint      AgileSprint @relation(fields: [sprintId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([sprintId, status])
}</textarea></div></div><div style="pointer-events: none;"><div class="CodeLines-module__reactCodeLineContainer__gIjxe CodeLines-module__scrollContainerHidden__g7TeZ" tabindex="0"><div class="react-code-file-contents CodeLines-module__codeFileContents__TXelD" data-isolate-layers="true" role="presentation" aria-hidden="true" data-tab-size="4" data-testid="code-lines-container" data-paste-markdown-skip="true" data-hpc="true" containertiming="hpc" style="tab-size: 4;
